summary: Comprehensive Mobile UX audit and implementation plan to make Sappy Stationary POS fully mobile-ready at 375px (and 320px/414px) without modifying desktop appearance or business logic. Covers the 5 core mobile fixes: wide tables to cards below 640px, non-wrapping tabular numbers/currency with clamp scaling, 16px minimum inputs with proper mobile keyboard inputmodes and autocompletes, 44px touch targets under coarse pointer media query, and safe-area insets with bottom clearance for fixed bars.
